review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the related shift API in TauCeti/Algebra/Category/GradedModuleCat/Shift.lean (shiftFunctor, shiftFunctorAddIso, shiftPowIso). The file builds one isomorphism, bimoduleTensorShiftIso, together with its naturality. It does this with the library's own bimoduleTensorLift, bimoduleTensorTmul and bimoduleTensorMap. I found no declaration that competes with a Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. The private declarations shiftPair/unshiftPair and shiftHom/unshiftHom are close to each other. This is repetition inside the file, not duplication of a Mathlib concept, so it falls outside this rubric. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for a graded-bimodule shift. The notion here is specific to TauCeti's GradedModuleCat, so I doubt one exists.
